title: Graph Databases
toolchain: Cypher: Kleppmann's cypher-shell (Traverse engine, node v24.2.0), from projects/databases/tools/cypher-shell: `printf "<query>;\n" | node cypher-shell.mjs ../../source/movies.tvdb` (the Bacon-number query takes ~80 s; asking for all length-6 paths from one actor to anyone aborts with 'Error: unreachable'). SQL: DuckDB v1.5.6, `duckdb -readonly projects/databases/source/movies.duckdb -c "<sql>"`. Anything that writes (Cypher CREATE/MERGE, SQL CREATE TABLE, CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH) only on a copy in your scratch folder, never on source/. SQL/PGQ: the duckpgq community extension (installed 2026-11-01); `LOAD duckpgq;` as its own statement before CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH. SQL blocks on screen: `Code(src, lang="sql")`. Quote results verbatim.
